objection_receipt.claim_scope: Default OS-source implementation and mGBA VFileMemChunk allocation-result flow only.
objection_receipt.finding: With no OS_SRC override, CMake selects src/util/memory.c. anonymousMemoryMap returns calloc(1, size), so success yields zeroed storage and allocation failure yields NULL; mappedMemoryFree ignores size and calls free. The VFileMemChunk path assigns that pointer but returns a VFile even if the buffer allocation failed; if input memory is non-NULL it then memcpy's without checking the destination. _vfmExpand likewise replaces mem with the allocator result and, when oldBuf exists, copies before freeing oldBuf without a NULL check. The GBA savedataRestore caller checks only whether VFileMemChunk returned a VFile, not whether its internal storage allocation succeeded.
objection_receipt.caller_result_contract: The caller receives the wrapper-level VFile pointer and cannot observe anonymousMemoryMap's NULL through a separate status result. This is a source-visible missing allocation-result propagation contract, not an observed crash.
